title: Italian-Style Braised Lamb Shanks
description: A hearty, slow-cooked lamb recipe with an Italian twist, perfect for a chilly evening. This dish is rich in flavor and falls-off-the-bone tender.
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°F (150°C). Season lamb shanks with salt and pepper.
Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Sear lamb until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes. Remove lamb and set aside.
Reduce heat to medium. Add onion, carrot, and celery. Cook, stirring occasionally, until vegetables are tender, about 10 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add red wine, beef broth, tomato paste, and oregano. Stir to combine.
Return lamb to the pot and bring to a boil. Cover and transfer to the preheated oven.
Braise lamb for 2 1/2 to 3 hours, or until tender and falling off the bone.
Remove lamb from the pot and cover with foil to keep warm.
Skim off excess fat from the braising liquid and season with salt and pepper.
Serve lamb with the rich, flavorful sauce spooned over the top.
